The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17d701d41c4cfec4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every s > 0 and α > 0, the following limits hold in operator norm on H: Jne−sGn J∗ n −→ Je−sG J∗ , (3.1) Jnα(α + Gn)−1 J∗ n −→ Jα(α + G)−1 J∗ . (3.2) Consequently the finite-dimensional laws of ξn converge to those of the stationary Liouville Brownian motion Bh.
